description: Caps what an agent wallet may spend in the Foundry each UTC day, and stops it, by signed message (personal_sign), never a transaction. action get (agent): its cap, today’s spending and whether it is stopped. action message (kind owner, set or release; agent, owner, cap?, stopped?): the exact text to sign. action apply (message, signature): checks and applies it. The agent names its owner once (kind owner, signed by the agent); from then on only the owner sets the cap and the stop switch (kind set) or lets it go (kind release). A stopped agent can pay for nothing here, and its running GPUs are stopped.

cap.description: USDG a UTC day; empty for no cap.

name: compute_budget
